headline: Revolut's Italian Branch Under Judicial Supervision for One Year: Anti-Money Laundering Controls Lacking
summary: Milan prosecutors requested the measure in a Financial Police investigation. Investigators cite anti-money-laundering control gaps that allegedly allowed concealment and transfer of €76.5 million in capital.
why: Revolut is a UK-based digital bank, and regulatory action over money-laundering controls can affect its licensing, costs and expansion plans.
